Current evidence is mixed and coverage-limited, so it does not support a reliable cycle phase or warning. Marks changed little between captures, while CFGI weakened, the earlier rich-breadth proxy was poor, and funding/open interest increased. Against that, direct ETHBTC closes remained above 0.03 and latest spot microstructure imbalances were positive. The API sequence cannot resolve the disagreement: 1h/4h/12h are unavailable, and the nominal 24h and 72h windows cover only 2 and 50 hours. This is not enough to distinguish a pause from failed transition, re-acceleration or persistent late-cycle deterioration. Protection calibration has no eligible matured rows and supplies no exit, pullback or re-entry rule.
